able.e: Enjoy your life while you are able to.
able.c: 能够的时候就好好享受人生吧。

about.e: There's a book about dancing on the desk.
about.c: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。

above.e: The moon and stars were shining above us.
above.c: 月亮和星星在上空照耀着。

add.e: Has anyone translated the Chinese sentences that I added?
add.c: 有没有人翻译过我添加的中文句子呢？

afraid.e: Don't be afraid to invest time and energy.

after.e: Hopefully you'll comply with traffic regulations after this.
after.c: 希望你们以后严格遵守交通规则。

again.e: I would like to talk with you again.
again.c: 我希望能再一次和你交谈。

all.e: We were shown all of their family photos.
all.c: 他们给我们看他们全部的家庭图片。

allow.e: They won't allow us to enter the garden.
allow.c: 他们不会允许我们进花园的。

also.e: He studies English, but he's also studying German.
also.c: 他学英语，但他也学德语。

although.e: Although old, he is still very much alive.
although.c: 虽然上了年纪，他依旧充满活力。

always.e: What a dictionary says is not always right.
always.c: 字典上写的不总是对的。

among.e: This movie is very popular among young people.
among.c: 这部电影在年轻人之间很流行。

and.e: He is young and, what is more, handsome.
and.c: 他很年轻，更重要的是，他很帅。

angry.e: Would you rather lie than make him angry?
angry.c: 你宁愿说谎也不愿让他生气吗？

animal.e: You should free those animals from the cage.
animal.c: 你应该把那些动物从笼里放出来。

another.e: We are waiting for him to make another decision.
another.c: 我们在等他做另一个决定。

any.e: Any further queries should be made via the customer service number below.
any.c: 如有任何其他疑问，请拨打下方的客服电话。

appear.e: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.
appear.c: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。

arm.e: The policeman seized the boy by the arm.
arm.c: 警察抓住了那个男孩的手臂。

as.e: A cell phone is as contaminated with bacteria as a toilet is.
as.c: 手机如同马桶一样被细菌污染。

at.e: The residents expressed their dissatisfaction at the noise.
at.c: 居民们对噪音表示了不满。

ball.e: Cats love to run after balls of wool.

be.e: Her father intends her to be a pianist.
be.c: 她的父亲想她成为一个钢琴家。

beautiful.e: Seen from space, the earth is very beautiful.
beautiful.c: 从太空里看，地球是个十分美丽的星球。

because.e: Because just one minute costs nearly four pounds.
because.c: 因为仅一分钟就要差不多花费4镑。

bed.e: I had to stay in bed all day.
bed.c: 我不得不一整天都呆在床上。

before.e: What do you think I was doing before?
before.c: 你觉得我之前在做什么？

being.e: I'm not ashamed of my father being poor.
being.c: 我父亲很穷并不让我觉得丢脸。

believe.e: I don't believe you. You're always telling lies.
believe.c: 我不相信你。你总是说谎。

below.e: Concerning the content below, I want to verify two things.
below.c: 关于下面的内容，我想确认两件事情。

between.e: There is only a marginal difference between the two.
between.c: 两者之间只有很小的差别。

big.e: I made a big mistake in choosing my wife.
big.c: 我在选择妻子时犯了一个很大的错误

bird.e: What do you call this bird in English?
bird.c: 这鸟你们用英语怎么称呼？

birthday.e: Today is mom's birthday. I ordered a cake.
birthday.c: 今天妈妈生日，我订了一个蛋糕。

black.e: Her pair of mountain boots are black.
black.c: 她的这双山地靴是黑色的。

blue.e: My car is not red, it is blue.
blue.c: 我的汽车不是红色的, 而是蓝色的。

body.e: Some medicines can be harmful to the body.
body.c: 有些药品会对身体产生危害。

book.e: He is reading a book in his room.
book.c: 他正在自己的房间里看书。

both.e: Many thousands on both sides had been wounded.

boy.e: Only one little boy survived the traffic accident.
boy.c: 这次交通事故中只有一个小男孩幸存了下来。

breakfast.e: My husband reads the newspaper while eating breakfast.
breakfast.c: 我丈夫一边吃早餐一边读报纸。

brother.e: My brother will often sit up all night.
brother.c: 我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。

busy.e: I have been busy writing a short story.
busy.c: 我一直忙于写一部短篇小说。

but.e: He is not a singer, but an actor.
but.c: 他不是歌手，但是个演员。

by.e: Ten years have gone by since his death.
by.c: 他死后已经过了十年的时间了。

bye.e: He departed without so much as saying good bye.
bye.c: 他连再见也不说就走了。

call.e: Please call me up between seven and eight.
call.c: 请在7点到8点钟之间打电话给我。

car.e: Imported cars account for less than eight percent.
car.c: 进口车占了不到百分之八。

cat.e: Our children like dogs, but I prefer cats.
cat.c: 我们的孩子喜欢狗，但我更喜欢猫。

chair.e: Unconsciously my mom took hold of the chair.
chair.c: 母亲无意中握住了椅子。

change.e: It appears that she might change her mind.

city.e: The transportation in this city is very convenient.
city.c: 这个城市的交通方便得很。

class.e: The class of forty includes eighteen girls.
class.c: 四十人的班级当中有十八位女生。

cold.e: This city is cold and lonely without you.
cold.c: 没有你，这座城市寒冷又孤寂。

consider.e: We can consider the problem from several standpoints.
consider.c: 我们可以从几个观点来考虑这个问题。

continue.e: The doctor continued to observe the patient's behavior.
continue.c: 医生继续观察病人的一举一动。

cool.e: Keep it in a cool place.

country.e: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
country.c: 许多国家的代表出席了会议。

create.e: Karlo has the ability to understand and create.

daughter.e: I have two daughters and two sons.
daughter.c: 我有两个女儿和两个儿子。

day.e: The days are getting longer and longer.

die.e: She was in despair when her husband died.
die.c: 丈夫去世时她十分绝望。

different.e: No one can have three different birth dates.
different.c: 三个不同的出生日期谁也不可能有。

dinner.e: I had a good dinner at his expense.
dinner.c: 他请我吃了顿美味的晚饭。

doctor.e: The doctor advised me to give up smoking.

dog.e: I have a black and white speckled dog.

door.e: The doors on the left side will open.

down.e: A ball is floating down the river.

during.e: He backed us up during that incident.
during.c: 他在那个事件期间支持我们。

each.e: Each robot is equipped with a talking machine.
each.c: 每个机器人身上都安装了一台发声器。

ear.e: He listened with his ear to the door.

early.e: My mother was too tired, so she went to bed early.
early.c: 我的母亲太累了，她早早地去睡了。

easy.e: English is not easy for him to learn.
easy.c: 英语对他来说是不容易学的。

even.e: Some national parks offer showers and even baby-sitting services.
even.c: 有些国家公园设有淋浴间，甚至还会提供托儿服务。

evening.e: I usually take a shower in the evening.

ever.e: I couldn't remember ever having met her.

every.e: Information is given in English at every airport.
every.c: 每个机场都有英文指示。

expect.e: The film wasn't as good as I'd expected.
expect.c: 电影没我期待的那么好。

eye.e: The eyes are the language of the heart.

face.e: He succeeded in the face of great difficulties.
face.c: 面对巨大的困难，他成功了。

family.e: He is the odd one of the family.

fast.c: 推销员经常是语速快的人。

father.e: We found out that he was her father.
father.c: 我们发现他是她的父亲。

few.e: Only a few TV programs are worth watching.
few.c: 只有为数不多的几个电视节目值得关注。

fine.e: I had a fine old time.
fine.c: 我有一段美好的旧时光。

first.e: It is the first step which is troublesome.

fish.e: Yesterday I went and fished by the river.

follow.e: Xiao Wang followed my advice and quit smoking.
follow.c: 小王听从了我的劝告，把烟戒了！

food.e: I consider fruit to be the healthiest food.
food.c: 我将水果视为最健康的食物。

for.e: For this test, I bought a voltage tester.
for.c: 为了这次的测试，我特地买了电压测试仪。

free.e: There's no such thing as a free lunch.

friend.e: Some of my friends can speak English well.
friend.c: 我的一些朋友英语说得很好。

from.e: Calm down and explain it from the beginning.
from.c: 你冷静下来，从头开始跟我说。

game.e: Children were apt to invent their own games.
game.c: 孩子们总爱创作自己的游戏。

girl.e: I want to marry a girl like her.
girl.c: 我想和一个像她那样的女孩结婚。

glad.e: I'm glad you could come to the party.
glad.c: 我很高兴你能来参加派对。

great.e: He was destined to become a great musician.
great.c: 他命中注定要成为伟大的音乐家。

green.e: What is that building with the green roof?
green.c: 那幢绿色屋顶的建筑是什么？

hair.e: I think your new hair color looks good.
hair.c: 我觉得你新的头发颜色好看。

hand.e: All essays must be handed in on time.
hand.c: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。

happen.e: I'm really sorry about what happened last night.
happen.c: 我对昨天晚上发生的事情感到非常的抱歉。

happy.e: We will become happy in the long run.
happy.c: 我们最终都会获得幸福的。

hard.e: Though I am tired, I will work hard.
hard.c: 虽然我很累，但我也会努力工作的。

head.e: He stared at me from head to foot.
head.c: 他把我从头到脚打量了一番。

heart.e: He died of a heart attack on the stage.
heart.c: 他是在舞台上心脏病发死的。

hello.e: Hello, girl with the red dress!

help.e: He kept his promise and helped his brothers.
help.c: 他履行了他的承诺，并且帮助了他的兄弟。

here.e: The people here are used to the cold.

high.e: That is a high building, is it not?

holiday.e: The holiday season is almost over.

home.e: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
home.c: 如果明天下雨，我们就呆在家。

hot.e: During hot season, perishables go bad easily.
hot.c: 在炎热的季节时，有些食品很容易变坏。

hour.e: They're required to work eight hours every day.
hour.c: 他们每天必须工作8小时。

house.e: Our house was robbed while we were away.
house.c: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。

how.e: How many boys are there in this class?

hungry.e: The hungry baby did nothing but cry.

if.e: If it rains tomorrow, we'll not go there.
if.c: 如果明天下雨，我们就不会去那里。

important.e: Language is one of man's most important inventions.
important.c: 语言是人类最重要的发明之一。

in.e: This rule does not apply in all cases.
in.c: 这条规则不是任何情况下都奏效的。

include.e: The woodwind section includes both pipes and reeds.
include.c: 木管乐器组中包含无簧片管乐器与簧片管乐器。

interesting.e: I need to find something interesting to do.
interesting.c: 我得找点有意思的事做。

into.e: We will turn the world into a paradise.
into.c: 我们会把人间变成天堂。

just.e: You can't be hungry. You've just had dinner.
just.c: 你刚刚才吃过晚饭，不可能饿得这么快的。

kill.e: The thin man killed the fat man.
kill.c: 瘦的男人杀死了胖的男人。

large.e: I prefer a phone with a large screen.
large.c: 我更喜欢萤幕大的手机。

last.e: At last, they experienced the joy of victory.
last.c: 最后，他们感受到了胜利的喜悦。

late.e: Should I be late, don't wait for me.
late.c: 万一我来晚的话，就别等我了。

leg.e: The newborn giraffe stumbled around on rickety legs.
leg.c: 新生的长颈鹿摇晃著腿跌跌撞撞地走。

letter.e: How many letters are there in the alphabet?
letter.c: 英文字母中有几个字母?

like.e: She loves the doll like her own sister.
like.c: 她像喜爱自己的亲妹妹一样喜欢这个娃娃。

line.e: They waited in line for the bus.

live.e: I'm tired of living this kind of life.

long.e: He was waiting for a long time.

look.e: The fresh snow looks beautiful on the hill.
look.c: 刚从天上降下来的雪，铺满了整个山头，看起来美丽极了。

love.e: Loving to work is the key to happiness.
love.c: 对工作的热爱是通往幸福的钥匙。

low.e: This desk is a little low for me.
low.c: 我觉得这张桌子低了点。

lunch.e: You can eat lunch here in this room.
lunch.c: 你可以在这房间吃午饭。

may.e: It may have rained a little last night.

minute.e: Because just one minute costs nearly four pounds.
minute.c: 因为仅一分钟就要差不多花费4镑。

money.e: I am short of money for my trip.

month.e: Some months have thirty days, others thirty one.
month.c: 有些月份有三十天，有些月份有三十一天。

moon.e: Mars has two small "moons," Phobos and Deimos.
moon.c: 火星上有两个小「月亮」，分别是福波斯和戴摩斯。

morning.e: I was busily typing for the whole morning.
morning.c: 整个上午，我都在忙着打字。

mother.e: My mother often said that time is money.
mother.c: 母亲常说时间就是金钱。

mountain.e: It's among the highest mountains in the Alps.
mountain.c: 这是阿尔卑斯山脉最高的山峰之一。

mouth.e: You must not speak with your mouth full.
mouth.c: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。

move.e: Sami is in the process of moving again.

mr.e: A Mr. Tanaka came to see you yesterday.
mr.c: 昨天有个田中先生来找您。

mrs.e: Mrs. Brown wrote a book on politics.
mrs.c: 布朗夫人写了一本关于政治的书。

music.e: The music carried me back to my childhood.
music.c: 这些音乐勾起了我儿时的回忆。

must.e: We must study the affair as a whole.
must.c: 我们必须总体地研究这事件。

name.e: We ought to sort the students' names alphabetically.
name.c: 我们应该把学生的名字跟着字母顺序来安排。

near.e: There is a beautiful park near my home.
near.c: 我家附近有个漂亮的公园。

need.e: Your project needs a large amount of money.
need.c: 你的项目需要一大笔钱。

never.e: Nancy never fails to arrive on time.
never.c: 南希从来没有不准时到达。

new.e: I think your new hair color looks good.
new.c: 我觉得你新的头发颜色好看。

next.e: If it's at all possible, I'd like you to take part in the next meeting.
next.c: 如果可能的话, 我希望你参加下一次的会议。

nice.e: There's nothing better than taking a nice walk.
nice.c: 没有什么比散步更好的了。

night.e: My brother will often sit up all night.
night.c: 我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。

nor.e: I cannot go, nor do I want to.

nose.e: Constantly blowing his nose in allergy season.
nose.c: 在过敏的季节不断地擤他的鼻子.

not.e: The end does not always justify the means.
not.c: 为了正当目的并非总是可以不择手段.

now.e: Now I will introduce you to my parents.
now.c: 现在我将把我的父母介绍给你。

number.e: Please tell me your name and telephone number.
number.c: 请你把你的名字和电话号码告诉我。

of.e: One of the children left the door open.
of.c: 其中一个孩子让门开著。

off.e: The old man set off at a quick trot.

offer.e: I expected him to offer some help.
offer.c: 我期待他提供一些帮助。

often.e: My brother will often sit up all night.
often.c: 我弟弟会经常彻夜不睡。

old.e: One is new, and the other is old.
old.c: 一个是新的，另一个是旧的。

on.e: There's a book about dancing on the desk.
on.c: 桌子上有一本关于舞蹈的书。

one.e: To be perfect she lacked just one defect.
one.c: 要变得完美，她就是少了一个缺点。

only.e: We thought his threat was only a joke.
only.c: 我们觉得他的威胁只是一个玩笑。

onto.e: He is just passing the blame onto others.

open.e: Open the window and you'll have fresh air.
open.c: 打开窗子，就会有新鲜空气了。

or.e: Which do you like better, this or that?
or.c: 你更喜欢哪个，这个还是那个？

other.e: We still have many other things to discuss.
other.c: 我们还有许多别的事情要讨论。

out.e: I'd like to check out right now.

over.e: He has over a million dollars in assets.
over.c: 他有超过一百万美元的资产。

own.e: She is firmly determined to own a store of her own.
own.c: 她下定决心要拥有自己的店。

page.e: The pages are turning yellow with the years.

paper.e: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
paper.c: 放在保险箱里面的文件不见了。

part.e: The participants were for the most part women.

pen.e: My pen isn't as good as yours.
pen.c: 我的钢笔不像你那支那么好。

people.e: Without an air conditioner, people nowadays cannot live.
people.c: 现今人们没有空调无法生活。

place.e: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
place.c: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

play.e: Must the woman always play the secondary role?
play.c: 女性永远只能扮演次要角色吗？

please.e: He does not seem pleased with his condition.
please.c: 他似乎对自己的状况不满意。

reach.e: Given good weather, we will reach there tomorrow.
reach.c: 如果天气好的话，我们明天就会到达了。

ready.e: Call me when you are ready to go.
ready.c: 准备好的话，致电给我吧。

red.e: Look at the house with the red roof.
red.c: 看看那间红色屋顶的房子。

remember.e: I can't remember when he moved to Boston.
remember.c: 我不记得他什么时候搬去波士顿了。

retired.e: He sold his business and retired.
retired.c: 他卖掉了他的事业并且退休。

right.e: Japanese cars' steering wheels are on the right.
right.c: 日本车的方向盘在右边。

river.e: The rivers were flooded by the heavy rain.

road.e: The road starts to suddenly rise from here.
road.c: 道路从这里开始陡然上升。

room.e: There's no space in the room for another bed.
room.c: 这间房间没有空间再放一张床了。

sad.e: Hearing the sad news, she collapsed in tears.
sad.c: 听到这个悲伤的消息，她泣不成声。

same.e: The same thing is happening here in Boston.
same.c: 同样的事在这－波士顿发生。

satisfying.e: I want a fuller, more satisfying social life.
satisfying.c: 我想要更充实、更令人满意的社交生活。

school.e: He goes to school to study every day.

sea.e: The octopus is an extremely intelligent sea creature.
sea.c: 章鱼是一种非常聪明的海洋生物。

second.e: Our friend finished the race in second place.
second.c: 我们的朋友完成了比赛，得了第二名。

seem.e: Some of them seem to be too difficult.

shall.e: Let's talk over a cup of tea, shall we?
shall.c: 我们用喝茶的时间谈谈，好吗？

short.e: I can't finish the job in so short a time.
short.c: 我无法在这么短的时间内完成这份工作。

since.e: It's been two years since I started learning Chinese.
since.c: 自从我开始学汉语以来已经有两年了。

sir.e: Sir, can we quickly inspect your luggage please?
sir.c: 先生，我们可以检查一下您的行李吗？

sister.e: How many sisters and brothers do you have?
sister.c: 你有几个姐姐,几个哥哥?

sky.e: The clouds floating in the sky are beautiful.

small.e: Sami grew up in a very small town.
small.c: 萨米在一座很小的城镇长大。

so.e: It's so obvious we don't need proof.
so.c: 事情如此明显所以我们不需要证明。

some.e: You'll have to manufacture some kind of excuse.
some.c: 你不得不制造一些借口。

sometimes.e: Sometimes, Grandma is more dangerous than the KGB.
sometimes.c: 有时候外婆比克格勃还危险。

son.e: He may well be proud of his sons.
son.c: 他完全可以为他的儿子们感到骄傲。

spend.e: I spend what time I can spare reading.
spend.c: 我把空闲时间全都花在阅读上。

sport.e: I know that you like sports.
sport.c: 我知道你喜欢体育运动。

star.e: The earth is not a star, but a planet.
star.c: 地球不是恒星，而是行星。

start.e: Starting tomorrow, I will begin a new job.
start.c: 明天开始，我要开始新的工作。

stay.e: How long are you going to stay here?

still.e: What happened to them is still a mystery.
still.c: 在他们身上发生了什么仍然是个谜。

stop.e: No one can bring time to a stop.

vie.e: I prefer your eau de vie to your conversation.
vie.c: 比起你的谈话，我更喜欢你的生命之水。

variability.e: Agriculture is vulnerable to weather and climate variability.
variability.c: 农业容易受到天气和气候变化的影响。

untouched.e: This part of Algeria is beautiful and untouched.
untouched.c: 阿尔及利亚的这一地区美丽且未受破坏。

imposing.e: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
imposing.c: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。

narcotic.e: This substance is a narcotic if inhaled.
narcotic.c: 如果吸入，该物质是一种麻醉剂。

chilly.e: It's a little chilly in here.

vitality.e: Health and vitality are important for long life.
vitality.c: 健康和活力对于长寿很重要。

persuasive.e: Am I being misled by his persuasive speech?
persuasive.c: 我是不是被他的说服性演讲误导了？

emanate.e: The threat emanating from Putin’s Russia will be difficult to counter.
emanate.c: 应对普京俄罗斯造成的威胁难度很大。 认识不到这样的威胁将进一步加大完成任务的难度。

ration.e: He was caught stealing rations at the kitchen.
ration.c: 他在厨房偷口粮时被捕。

evade.e: Sami was thrown in jail for evading arrest.
evade.c: 萨米因逃避逮捕而被投入监狱。

forefront.e: Respect should be at the forefront.

sophistication.e: His black-rimmed glasses added an air of sophistication.
sophistication.c: 黑框眼镜增添了一丝干练的气质。

adventurous.e: I'm not adventurous enough to try doing that.
adventurous.c: 我没有足够的冒险精神来尝试这样做。

sever.e: Ziri found a severed hand in the trunk.
sever.c: 齐里在行李箱里发现了一只断手。

pry.e: Don't pry into the affairs of others.

denomination.e: What denominations would you like that in?

redeem.e: The only thing that will redeem mankind is co-operation.
redeem.c: 合作是人类唯一的救赎。

humane.e: Isn't that the most humane punishment for criminals?
humane.c: 这难道不是对罪犯最人道的惩罚吗？

enthusiastically.e: He enthusiastically engaged himself in this honorable undertaking.
enthusiastically.c: 她热忱地投身于这份光荣的事业。

upheaval.e: The upheavals resulting from momentous technological change are rarely expected. The telegraph disrupted the postal service.
upheaval.c: 人们很少料到重大技术革命所带来的动荡。 电报葬送了邮政。 收音机和电视扰乱了报纸。 飞机终结了远洋客轮。 发明总是充满活力；这也解释了为什么未来永远像过去那样令人振奋。

defer.e: I don't want to defer your wishes.

curtail.e: Their efforts to curtail spending didn't quite succeed.
curtail.c: 他们削减开支的努力并未取得成功。

relinquish.e: They will relinquish power and dismantle the single-party state.
relinquish.c: 他们将放弃权力并废除一党制国家。

contingent.e: Our departure tomorrow is contingent on fair weather.
contingent.c: 我们明天出发要视天气情况而定。

refrigerate.e: Refrigerate them to keep them as fresh as possible.
refrigerate.c: 将它们冷藏以尽可能保持新鲜。

continuum.e: We live in a space-time continuum.
continuum.c: 我们生活在一个时空连续体中。

entertainer.e: He made good as an entertainer.
entertainer.c: 他作为一名艺人表现出色。

dazzling.e: There is a full dazzling sun out today.

replica.e: This is a replica of a dinosaur's egg.

condemnation.e: ISIS's brutality deserves our strongest possible condemnation.
condemnation.c: 伊斯兰国的残暴行为值得我们最强烈的谴责。

moth.e: Is it a butterfly or a moth?
moth.c: 这是一只蝴蝶还是一只飞蛾？

influx.e: Initial readings indicate an influx of toxic chemicals.
influx.c: 初步读数表明有毒化学品大量涌入。

terrifying.e: This kind of odour is really terrifying.

emulate.e: Every child needs someone to admire and emulate.
emulate.c: 每个孩子都需要有人钦佩和效仿。

banish.e: He's going to be banished from this land.

abandonment.e: How do you deal with issues of abandonment?

supernatural.e: Did some supernatural forces try to stop you?
supernatural.c: 有没有一些超自然力量试图阻止你？

allude.e: I never alluded to an intent to marry.
allude.c: 我从来没有提到过要结婚的意图。

epic.e: I like lyric better than epic.
epic.c: 我喜欢抒情诗多于史诗。

informative.e: This is a very informative article.
informative.c: 这是篇信息量很大的文章。

seduce.e: He seduced her with his didgeridoo.
seduce.c: 他用他的迪吉里杜管勾引了她。

coax.e: She coaxed him out of his dark mood.
coax.c: 她把他从阴郁的情绪中哄了出来。

intruder.e: I will be no longer an intruder here.
intruder.c: 我将不再是这里的入侵者。

repetitive.e: I feel worn out by my repetitive days.
repetitive.c: 日复一日的重复让我感到疲惫不堪。

renovate.e: Our venue wasn't renovated too long ago.
renovate.c: 我们的场地不久前翻新了。

meteor.e: Tomorrow we are going to see the meteor shower!

adjoining.e: Sami and Layla rented two adjoining rooms.
adjoining.c: 萨米和莱拉租了两间相邻的房间。

eminent.c: 他成为现代哲学界的杰出人物。

guise.e: Don't patronize me under the guise of concern.
guise.c: 别打着关心的幌子来光顾我。

accompaniment.c: 我想在他的钢琴伴奏下唱歌。

pathogen.e: Have I been exposed to the pathogen?

pulp.c: 借由煮沸以减少黏浆状物质。

bland.e: Life would become bland without you.
bland.c: 如果没有你，我的人生就会变得空白一片。

seep.e: That fear started to seep into Ziri's head.
seep.c: 这种恐惧开始渗入兹里的脑海。

vista.e: Researchers announce method of circumventing Windows Vista security features.
vista.c: 研究人员公布了绕过 Windows Vista 安全功能的方法。

unravel.e: As the story advances, the mystery unravels.
unravel.c: 随着故事的进行，谜题揭开了。

trough.e: He put the clothes in the trough.

refinement.e: You look like a woman of refinement.
refinement.c: 你看起来像个精致的女人。

amazement.c: 他张开了嘴巴说不出话来。

avid.e: I am an avid lover of early music.
avid.c: 我是早期音乐的狂热爱好者。

paramount.e: Algeria is of a paramount importance to Africa.
paramount.c: 阿尔及利亚对非洲至关重要。

notoriously.e: Their roads are notoriously tough on cars.
notoriously.c: 他们的道路对汽车来说非常艰难。

stained.e: His shirt was stained with sauce.
stained.c: 他的衬衫被酱汁弄脏了。

mythology.e: In Greek mythology, Ares was the god of war.
mythology.c: 在希腊神话中，阿瑞斯是战争之神。

rampant.c: 在猖獗的恐同者中，有许多潜在的同性恋者。

shred.e: Sami was torn to shreds by a cougar.
shred.c: 萨米被美洲狮撕成碎片。

stipulate.e: Why wouldn't you stipulate that in the contract?
stipulate.c: 为什么不在合同里注明呢？

automotive.c: 我们来谈谈阿尔及利亚的汽车工业。

instinctive.c: 无人机竞速是一项需要本能反应的高速运动。

veer.e: Sami's car suddenly veered off, speeding away.
veer.c: 萨米的车突然转向，加速驶去。

supersede.e: The new rules will supersede the old ones.

elegance.e: Venus is a symbol of femininity and elegance.
elegance.c: 金星是女性气质和优雅的象征。

refreshing.e: A glass of cold water is very refreshing in hot weather.
refreshing.c: 一杯冷水在暑热的天气里十分提神。

ailment.e: The doctor said that this ailment is incurable.
ailment.c: 医生说这种病无法治愈。

irresistible.c: 你这身穿著让人无法抗拒。

recourse.e: They had no other recourse but to apologize.
recourse.c: 除了道歉之外，他们没有其他办法。

rumble.e: Your stomach has been rumbling for quite a while now. Are you sure you're all right?
rumble.c: 刚才你肚子一直在叫，没事吧？

subside.e: Let's wait until the heat subsides a bit.
subside.c: 让我们等热度稍微减弱一点。

professionalism.e: I salute both of you for your professionalism.
professionalism.c: 我向你们俩的专业精神致敬。

rhythmic.e: Rhythmic gymnastics is a beautiful sport for girls.
rhythmic.c: 艺术体操对于女孩来说是一项美丽的运动。

endlessly.e: I'm getting endlessly annoyed by this foolishness.
endlessly.c: 我对这种愚蠢的行为表示非常的气愤。

illicit.e: It's illicit to have sex outside of marriage.

rift.e: Sami's drinking caused a rift in his marriage.
rift.c: 萨米的酗酒导致他的婚姻出现裂痕。

skeptic.e: I'll admit I was a skeptic at first.
skeptic.c: 我承认我一开始是持怀疑态度的。

disarm.e: A policeman approached Ziri and disarmed him instantly.
disarm.c: 一名警察走近齐里并立即解除了他的武装。

improvise.e: They improvised most of their lines.
improvise.c: 他们的台词大部分都是即兴发挥的。

assortment.e: There's an assortment of fruit in the box.
assortment.c: 盒子里有各种各样的水果。

impede.e: I hope it doesn't impede my online classes.
impede.c: 我希望这不会影响我的在线课程。

stringent.e: We need to introduce more stringent security measures.
stringent.c: 我们需要采取更严格的安全措施。

needy.e: We do this to help the needy.
needy.c: 我们这样做是为了帮助有需要的人。

hypothesize.e: The scientist hypothesized the result of the experiment.
hypothesize.c: 科学家对实验结果做出了假设。

petal.e: The petals are floating on the water.

retrospective.e: Kirsty went to the art gallery to see the Matisse retrospective.
retrospective.c: 柯斯蒂去美术馆看马蒂斯回顾展。

falter.e: We never saw him hesitate or falter.
falter.c: 我们从未见过他犹豫或犹豫。

celestial.e: The solar system is a small celestial system in the Milky Way.
celestial.c: 太阳系是银河系中一个小的天体系统。

mundane.e: Sadako realized that, near death, even what was once mundane glows with an everlasting beauty.
mundane.c: 贞子意识到，在生命将尽之际，曾经平凡无奇的事物，也会散发永恒的美。

purport.e: The text did not purport to be comprehensive.

tavern.e: Lackadaisy! The tavern has run out of ale.
tavern.c: 懒惰！酒馆里的啤酒已经卖完了。

assassin.e: Jonas hired the best assassin in the prison.
assassin.c: 乔纳斯雇佣了监狱里最好的刺客。

cedar.e: There used to be a large cedar tree there.
cedar.c: 那里以前有一棵高大的雪松树。

etch.e: The incident was etched in his memory.

avoidance.e: This is an egregious example of tax avoidance.
avoidance.c: 这是一个极其恶劣的避税例子。

smear.c: 为什么你这么喜欢黑中国？

enlightenment.e: Vesak is a Buddhist holiday which celebrates the birth, enlightenment and death of the Buddha.
enlightenment.c: 卫塞节是佛教的一个节日，纪念佛陀的诞生、成道和涅槃。

outright.e: The party achieved an outright majority by a hair.
outright.c: 该党以微弱优势获得绝对多数席位。

plumbing.e: Who can I call to fix my plumbing?
plumbing.c: 我可以打电话给谁来修理我的管道？

infuse.e: This soap is infused with natural fragrances.
infuse.c: 这块肥皂里添加了天然香料。

spontaneously.e: Spontaneously kissing guys has become a habit of Rima's.
spontaneously.c: 自发地亲吻男人已经成为莉玛的习惯。

trickle.e: A trickle of blood ran down his neck.
trickle.c: 一股血顺着他的脖子流了下来。

perennial.e: Bushfires are a perennial menace in Australia.
perennial.c: 丛林大火是澳大利亚长期存在的威胁。

presumption.e: He had the presumption to reject my proposal.
presumption.c: 他有推定拒绝我的提议。

wail.e: She was wailing when her son passed away.
wail.c: 当她的儿子去世时，她正在哭泣。

lyric.e: I found the lyrics, but I can't copy-paste them.
lyric.c: 我找到了歌词，但是没法转贴过来。

salvage.e: The wreckage of the ship was salvaged after it had gone to Davy Jones's locker.
salvage.c: 船的残骸从海底被打捞上来。

soybean.e: Milking soybeans must be a tiring task, all that squeezing.
soybean.c: 挤大豆肯定是很累人的工作，需要不停地挤压。

workload.e: This is too heavy a workload for me.
workload.c: 这对我来说工作量太大了。

accomplished.c: 我们所取得的成就令人惊叹。

apparel.e: Warm and comfortable apparel is necessary for winter outings.
apparel.c: 冬季出行需要保暖舒适的服装。

congestion.e: Congestion is a problem in every big city.
congestion.c: 拥堵是每个大城市都面临的问题。

buckle.e: The roof of the house suddenly buckled.

ancestral.e: They know that Algeria is their ancestral home.
ancestral.c: 他们知道阿尔及利亚是他们的祖籍。

homage.e: I meant to pay homage to her with that.
homage.c: 我本来想以此向她致敬。

pioneering.e: He did pioneering work in the field of physical geography.
pioneering.c: 他在自然地理科学界取得了突破性的成果。

viability.e: The viability of the project needs to be studied.
viability.c: 需要研究该项目的可行性。

conservatory.e: Shall we retire to the conservatory, Your Grace?
conservatory.c: 陛下，我们可以去音乐学院退休吗？

mitigate.e: The answer is no. Monetary policy cannot mitigate the damage done by foolish trade policies.
mitigate.c: 答案是否定的。 因为货币政策并不能减少愚蠢贸易政策所造成的损害。

soothe.e: The plush fur of the toy felt so soft and somehow soothing.
soothe.c: 那个玩具绒毛摸起来很柔软，让人感到舒适。

infirmary.e: You had better go to the infirmary.

vantage.e: From my vantage point, I can't see the action.
vantage.c: 从我的角度来看，我看不到行动。

puddle.e: Angrily, he stomped on the puddle, splashing mud everywhere.
puddle.c: 他愤怒地践踏水坑，弄得泥水四溅。

symbolism.c: 他们分析了书中的象征意义。

ceremonial.e: Dressed in ceremonial garb, he began the ritual.
ceremonial.c: 他身着盛装，开始了仪式。

lavish.c: 雅尼住在阿尔及利亚的一座豪华豪宅里。

milestone.c: 那天是我们项目的一个重要里程碑。

lineage.e: The young rabbi often brags about his lineage.
lineage.c: 这位年轻的拉比经常吹嘘他的血统。

vegetarian.e: She's vegetarian, so she ate tofu instead of turkey.
vegetarian.c: 她是素食者，所以她没吃火鸡，而是吃了豆腐。

clinch.e: Now is the time to clinch the deal.
clinch.c: 现在是达成协议的时候了。

potter.c: 哈利波特的新片十分差。

conservatism.e: But Bush, following the terrorist attacks of 2001, turned his back on conservatism.
conservatism.c: 但是，布什自2001年恐怖袭击以来背离了保守主义。 他寻求改造中东，其途径不仅是推翻阿富汗的塔利班政权和伊拉克的萨达姆政权，而且还高声呼吁民主化。

conglomerate.e: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

gull.e: Gulls were flying above the sea.

seasoning.e: I need some seasoning. What do you have?
seasoning.c: 我需要一些调味料。你有什么？

cohesion.e: Academic writing needs to show cohesion and coherence.
cohesion.c: 学术写作需要表现出凝聚力和连贯性。

mediator.e: Let's settle the matter without a mediator.
mediator.c: 让我们在没有调解人的情况下解决问题吧。

bouquet.e: Sami put Layla's bouquet in his room.
bouquet.c: 萨米将莱拉的花束放在了他的房间里。

subsistence.c: 这是对其生存的必要贡献。

stunt.e: I don't think that it's just a stunt.
stunt.c: 我不认为这只是一个噱头。

shun.c: 缅甸是一个与世隔绝的国家，排斥外来者。

touching.c: 放开我的手臂！我不能忍受有人碰我。

baroque.c: 别墅里有一间巴洛克风格的大房间。

devastation.c: 不幸和灾难总是相伴而行。

heed.c: 她不把我们的警告放在心上。

derivative.e: Salicylates come from salicylic acid and its derivatives.
derivative.c: 水杨酸盐来自水杨酸及其衍生物。

lurch.e: I knew you wouldn't leave me in the lurch.
lurch.c: 我就知道你不会丢下我不管。

incorporation.e: The articles of incorporation have finally been completed for our Digital Groove Club.
incorporation.c: 我们的 Digital Groove Club 的公司章程终于完成了。

flea.c: 你能告诉我跳蚤市场在哪里吗？

concur.e: Is it just me? Or do you concur?
concur.c: 只有我吗？或者你同意吗？

glaze.e: The baker glazed the buns with sugar syrup.
glaze.c: 面包师在面包上涂上糖浆。

fauna.e: We don't gave gazelles as local fauna here.
fauna.c: 我们不将瞪羚视为这里的当地动物群。

expansive.c: 我从来没有见过如此广阔的风景。

prod.c: 不要那样用叉子戳食物。

depreciation.c: 阿尔及利亚第纳尔是否面临更大贬值？

engender.c: 并不是白发能产生智慧。

artisan.c: 数千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出这座令人惊叹的白色大理石建筑。

dissertation.c: 我最近真忙于我的毕业论文。

metabolism.c: 尽管是流亡者国度中的流亡者，尽管没有谁能够真正归属于这个国度，但我觉得自己的归属感却前所未有的强烈，2001年的9月11日，就像肯尼迪总统在柏林，这座前国家社会主义的首都即将沦为共产主义都会之际宣告自己是柏林人一样，我终于能够骄傲地宣称 ， “ 我是纽约人 ！ ”

daisy.e: There are daisies next to the steel building.

emancipation.e: The Next Stage of Women’s Emancipation?

psychoanalysis.c: 在那个年代，心理学的两个主要学派是行为主义学派与精神分析学派。

yen.c: 我用两千日元买了这本书。

motionless.c: 老人站在门口一动不动。

incompetent.c: 社会上满是不称职的医生。

footnote.c: 勒德分子在很多方面都是错的；但也许他们并不只是一个注脚而已。

aloft.c: 我看见一群鸟在高空飞翔。

influenza.c: 高烧是流感的常见症状。

dizzying.c: 这些汽车可以在直道上达到令人眼花缭乱的速度。

kiln.c: 电窑可以轻松控制温度。

appall.c: 每次看到这些照片我都会感到震惊。

entrenched.c: 敌人已盘踞在首都四面八方。

cosmopolitan.c: 记者就是所谓的世界主义者。

additive.c: 这种果酱中没有添加任何添加剂。

detectable.e: A smaller, but still dangerous, concentration of pathogens won't necessarily be detectable by smell.
detectable.c: 较小但仍然危险的病原体浓度不一定可以通过气味检测到。

aversion.c: 我对你的吸引力已经变成了厌恶。

chronology.c: 我在此断言他的年表是正确的。

insomnia.c: 我有失眠症，所以睡得不好。

serenity.c: 我喜欢她。她向我传达了平静。

colossal.c: 他的脚上有一个巨大的赘生物。

meander.c: 河流蜿蜒流过广阔的干旱平原。

dilution.c: 没有水，就无法制备药物制剂和稀释液。

raucous.c: 喧闹的人群使现场气氛活跃起来。

astute.c: 精明的读者应该愿意权衡他们读到的所有内容，包括匿名来源。

hoax.c: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。

unquestionably.c: 埃亚勒·哈达德无疑是因反犹太主义原因被谋杀的。

philharmonic.c: 昨天我参加了维也纳爱乐乐团的一场音乐会。

choreographer.c: 我不是编舞家，但我想成为。

surmise.c: 警方推测受害人告诉了他们真相。

acronym.c: 谁能告诉我TATOEBA首字母缩合词的意思？

vigilance.c: 人生的成功在于勤奋和警惕。

kerosene.c: 在下雪很多的地方，煤油是不可或缺的东西。

confluence.c: 这段河流有许多交汇处。

jeweler.c: 宝石师傅在胸针上镶了一枚大珍珠。

laurel.c: 据说月桂叶茶可以对抗失眠。

complicity.c: 一种强烈的共谋把他和她联系在一起。

lipid.c: 光滑内质网是负责脂质合成的细胞器。

puzzling.c: 而1989年留下的、最令人迷惑的遗产则被中国领导人收下。 苏东阵营的分崩离析曾令他们心惊胆战，中共官员在当年三月如此总结道 ： “ 应尽一切努力，以阻止东欧剧变对中国的内部发展产生影响 。 ” 之后数月内，他们便对民主抗议者进行了暴力镇压。

fanciful.c: 他的想法常常很奇特，但总是原创的。

porous.c: 白色胶水可用于任何光滑、多孔的表面。

populous.c: 奥斯陆是挪威人口最多的城市。

perseverance.c: 就像你们知道的那样，毅力是成功的关键。

methodically.c: 这是为了教我有条不紊地思考。

flamboyant.c: 我不认为我有一个华丽的个性。

brandish.c: 她一边尖叫，一边挥舞着刀。

tarnish.e: Sami was trying to tarnish Layla's reputation.
tarnish.c: 萨米试图玷污莱拉的名誉。

allegory.e: That's an allegory. Do you know what that is?
allegory.c: 这是一个寓言。你知道那是什么吗？

outgrow.c: 杂草很快就会超过花朵。

affliction.c: 一个人的盛宴对另一个人来说就是一种痛苦。

uproot.c: 伊拉克战争已导致数百万人流离失所。

divulge.c: 萨米没有透露太多关于他自己的事情。

unscrupulous.c: 很多公立学校的食堂都很黑心。

wavy.c: 他有波浪状的棕色头发和深色的眼睛。

embroider.c: 我不知道如何缝纫或刺绣。

tolerable.e: Your actions are tolerable, as a kid.

credence.c: 她的眼泪使这个故事更加可信。

retract.c: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

illustrious.c: 马西尼萨是努米底亚最杰出的国王。

felt.c: 他在口袋里摸着找他的钱包。

bravado.c: 真正的勇敢与虚张声势完全不同。

outlying.c: 阿尔及利亚需要将其边远地区与更发达的北部地区融为一体。

ultimatum.c: 您应该如何应对银行的最后通牒？

turquoise.c: 大海是绿松石色的，水温暖而平静。

ambience.c: 里面开了一个个欧式的小店，情调好极了！

comprehensible.c: 法律术语是大多数普通人无法理解的。

sumptuous.e: I am living in a sumptuous palace.

sustenance.c: 长颈鹿依靠相思叶来维持生计。

eccentricity.c: 你不应该注意他的怪癖。

morbid.c: 他对谋杀之谜有着病态的偏爱。

slacken.c: 澳大利亚是否会放宽移民规定？

chirp.c: 蟋蟀的叫声与蛙鸣催我入眠。

vertigo.c: 他有眩晕症，他不应该上树。

impervious.e: This material is completely impervious to water.

disprove.c: 日本反驳了对计算机芯片倾销的虚假指控。

yardstick.c: 杰克逊先生拿起一个尺度进行测量。

choreograph.c: 舞蹈老师正在编排她的舞团。

invalidate.e: Ziri doesn't want to invalidate his ablutions.

defunct.e: The statue stood as a remnant of a defunct civilization.

raven.e: Why is a raven like a writing desk?

pretentious.c: 你为自己自命不凡而自豪，不是吗？

inquisitive.c: 我的好奇心使我内心年轻。

incoherent.c: 当Yanni喝醉的时候，他是一个不连贯的混乱。
